prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-cut demi statue portrait, a 12-cell stone-only grid body (6 rows, two columns), every cell physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh-stub tips just below her hip line, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Italian woman in 1960s Italian film-star makeup — warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, thick glossy dark-brown hair set in a high backcombed style, a smouldering, confident expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a large real pearl drop with a gold clip.

Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — shoulders more than four times a normal woman's width, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, no waist at all, hips as broad as the shoulders, body divided into a 12-cell grid (6 rows, two columns), each cell a different stone variant, stepped seams.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Below the collarbones, her body is divided into a grid of 12 cells — 6 horizontal rows stacked top to bottom, crossed by one vertical line down the centre splitting each row into a left and right cell — each cell with a raised stepped edge and shadow at every border, no gaps, no skin anywhere, every cell a genuinely different variant of the same stone material family. Row 1 (her whole left arm and left chest / her whole right arm and right chest): left cell carved solid vivid sky-blue turquoise with dark matrix veining, completely opaque; right cell carved solid banded green malachite with concentric rings, completely opaque. Row 2 (left / right body band 2): left cell carved solid deep grey labradorite that flashes blue-green light, completely opaque; right cell carved solid bright blue-green amazonite streaked with white feldspar, completely opaque. Row 3 (left / right body band 3): left cell carved solid banded black and white onyx, completely opaque; right cell carved solid deep royal-blue lapis lazuli with golden pyrite flecks, completely opaque. Row 4 (left / right body band 4): left cell carved solid polished black obsidian with faint internal swirls, completely opaque; right cell carved solid white Carrara marble veined with soft grey streaks, completely opaque. Row 5 (left / right body band 5): left cell carved solid golden-brown tiger's eye with a silky chatoyant band, completely opaque; right cell carved solid deep blue sodalite with fine white veining, completely opaque. Row 6 (left thigh-stub tip / right thigh-stub tip): left cell carved solid reddish-brown jasper with fine banding, completely opaque, rounding off at its tip; right cell carved solid soft pink rhodochrosite with white banding, completely opaque, rounding off at its tip.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a bright cobalt blue on one side and a warm golden yellow on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so blue light glances off one side and yellow light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam in the grid. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
